overview_description.description: ZELOS is a performance management tool building smarter track and field teams to better manage their competitive season and identify trends in progress. Their mission is to provide a globally accessible platform as a vehicle for individual empowerment, data literacy, and social mobility within athletics. It was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States.
